stage: /assets/twin/2/stage.js (v2 = v1 + loadTwinAsset); the other stage twins stay on v1

coordinates.authoring: Blender +X right, +Y away from the street, +Z up
coordinates.gltf: glTF/three.js +X right, +Y up, +Z towards the street
coordinates.plan: Identical to the page plan in cafe/index.html createCafeScene (FY = 0.15 m finished floor). The GLB is added at identity: no scale, no offset.

state_owner: The CAFE model in cafe/index.html owns every queue, order, ticket, plate, table, stock level, special, roster and number. The GLB has no state, timer or logic. visualStateFromModel() only reads the model; setVisualState() only sets visibility, pivots, one scale and emissive levels.
part_groups: Node extras.twin_part names the page pickable group (G[...]) each authored part joins: counter, coffee, cabinet, app, door, kitchen, pass, office, board, bin, tables, out, footpath. Nodes without one (walls) are not pickable but still block picks.

mode.rule: café: cup stack; dinner: bar shelves and taps, host stand, candles

station.rule: visible in café mode while the lever is on; it is a proposal, not equipment the venue has

queue.rule: spot i shows the occupied (blush) material while i < queue length; people themselves are the page instanced figures

espresso.rule: angle 0 (locked in) while coffees are queued; L +0.7 rad, R -0.7 rad (swung out) when idle

kitchen.rule: visible when load > 0; emissive 0.6 + 0.8 x load (blue gas flame)

pass.source: plates at the pass: d.pass with out < 0 and not app (-2)
pass.rule: emissive 1.4 while plates wait; 0.25 during trading hours; 0 closed

app.source: an app order placed in the last 1.5 simulated minutes

bin.rule: fill scale Y = clamp(binKg / 28, 0.02, 1) x 0.9 about its base; lid -0.5 rad about local X (hinge) above 22 kg

umbrellas.source: K.outdoorOK(d.wx, t, mode) during trading hours, smoothed by the page (instant under reduced motion)
umbrellas.rule: u in 0..1: radial scale 0.18 + 0.82u, axial 2 - u, about the apex

lamps.source: page lamp level (dark and open), the same value that drives the maquette lights

street_view.rule: visible only in the street view (as the maquette)

cabinet.rule: portion k visible while k < min(8, ceil(stock / 4)) (the maquette rule); CAB_ITEM_SPECIAL visible while d.special[item]

boards.rule: UV 0..1 faces; the page draws both live (menu: items on the menu, current price, sold out, on special; roster: rostered vs needed). glTF UVs: canvas textures need flipY = false.

browser_simplifications: The browser replaces cafe_glass_simplified with a thin Fresnel-alpha pane to keep overlapping display glass sharp. The source retains physical transmission; prepared AR uses its documented alpha approximation. Browser, Cycles and AR lighting differ.
Lamp, heat-lamp, flame and screen light is emissive material only; the page keeps its own warm point lights.
ambientCG timber, fabric and terrazzo PBR textures; both boards are live canvases drawn by the page.
Materials do not switch with the page dark theme (the maquette card does).
limits: Kinematic display geometry, not a fit-out drawing, an equipment spec or a measured venue.
The venue is fictional. Equipment is generic and unbranded.
Nothing in the model is live data; everything it shows is the simulation's state.
